messages:
maria (marketing): Draft for the Redwood Optimize launch post is in Drive. Need quick votes: publish time, hero quote, and partner greenroom plan.

jon (growth): Can we do Wed 9:00 PT? That gives PR and partners a full business day heads-up. Also want a short hero CTA that pushes webinar signups.

rishi (product): Wed works. Confirming numbers to cite: ~36% lower unit cost and 2.3x median latency improvement vs our baseline. We'll include a 1-paragraph methodology link.

taylor (growthops): HubSpot routing draft: blog -> list: optimize_launch_2026; webinar form -> tag: webinar_early; clicks on benchmark CTA -> workflow: nurture_optimize. Will append utm_campaign=optimize_launch and utm_experiment=headlineTest.

kate (legal): Legal quick pass: no absolutes, include this footnote exactly: "Benchmarks run on Redwood eval-suite; representative workloads only. Methodology: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/optimize-2026" Also require "Used with permission" under partner quotes.

sam (design): Need final hero image (1200x630), image alt text, and a 60-char hero quote. Uploaded two art directions to Drive (modern chart vs product dashboard).

hannah (pr): Partner greenroom plan: send embargoed preview to partners + top press list 48h before publish. We'll ask partners to withhold public sharing until embargo lifts. Also prepping a short FAQ for press.

maria (marketing): Hero candidates: A) "Reduce inference cost by 36% with Redwood Optimize" B) "2.3x faster median latency in our benchmark" Which should be headlineA vs B for the A/B test?

jon (growth): A/B both headline and CTA. HeadlineA=cost, HeadlineB=latency. CTA A="Register for webinar" CTA B="Read the benchmark". Track with `?utm_experiment=headlineA` etc.

taylor (growthops): I'll configure the experiment and map registrations -> `optimize_sdr` queue when role indicates "platform" or "infra". Also add `lead_source=launch_post` field on the HubSpot form.

rishi (product): Landing page will include short FAQ and a one-paragraph methodology excerpt linking to the full appendix. I'll paste copy into doc in 20m.

kate (legal): Add consent language on forms: "By registering you agree to receive communications from Redwood." Legal attaches Doc IDs for partner approvals.

sam (design): Uploaded OG image file `optimize-hero-final.png`. Alt text candidate: "chart comparing latency and cost before and after Optimize". Need final hero quote (<=60 chars).

maria (marketing): Final hero quote draft (60 chars): "Optimize inference: faster responses, lower unit cost." Tightening for length. Also planning embargo meta header for partner preview URL.

hannah (pr): For greenroom send: include 1-paragraph product summary, embargo date/time, social do's and don'ts, and a one-click calendar invite for the webinar. We'll need partner list by EOD Tue.

publish-bot: Publish checklist: missing items -> hero quote (final), testimonial approval file, and OG alt confirmation. Run `/schedule publish 2026-04-15T16:00Z` after checklist complete.

taylor (growthops): I'll set embargo URL (password-protected) and the meta header `X-Embargo: 2026-04-15T16:00Z`. Also will validate HubSpot flows in staging.

jon (growth): For emails, subject test: A="Reduce inference costs 36% with Redwood Optimize" B="See 2.3x faster LLM responses in our benchmark". Add `?utm_experiment=subjA` / `subjB`.

kate (legal): :thumbsup: on hero quote phrasing. Confirmed partner approvals attached in Drive. No more edits from legal.

rishi (product): :thumbsup: landing page ready to accept copy. Webinar widget scheduled for Apr 22 10:00 PT.

maria (marketing): Final QA checklist for Friday: 1) hero quote locked 2) testimonial file attached 3) HubSpot routing tested 4) subject/headline experiments configured 5) partner greenroom list ready. Please react :thumbsup: if green.

jon (growth): :thumbsup:
taylor (growthops): :thumbsup:
sam (design): :thumbsup:
kate (legal): :thumbsup:
hannah (pr): :thumbsup:
rishi (product): :thumbsup:
maria (marketing): Locking publish Wed 2026-04-15 09:00 PT if no objections. I'll run `/schedule publish 2026-04-15T16:00Z` when the missing items are uploaded. Thanks!
